text.text_excerpt: Tried this food truck outside of Tulane Medical Center. It's a pretty popular place for food trucks during lunch so it's sometimes a tough sell to hospital employees, especially if you are new. I think that Yami Foods will do well though. The price is a little high for a food truck, but you do get a lot of food for your money. I got the veggie hibachi with 2 sides: stir fried rice and California roll. It was like $9.50 which was pretty good for that much food. There was a lot of flavor in everything and the sushi roll tasted fresh. The other sides sounded really good as well. My coworker got the steak hibachi with gyoza and noodles and really liked it. I think next time I'm going to get t...

I finally tried this truck that is usually near my work 2x per week. I had the salmon hibachi plate. The salmon was perfectly cooked and they were out of my first choice, California roll, but I had edamame and really yummy mini serving of seaweed salad. All the food was really tasty but the portion size was a bit small for the price. Maybe the meat portions are greater. Would definitely try again

Love me some Yami Foods! I visited their truck for the first time today during Picnicking on Poydras, which is a food-truck oriented lunchtime event that happens near the 'Dome on Poydras. (check out @nolafoodtrucks on IG to see when it happens if you're into food truck munchies) Anywho, I went with the Sushi Roll Lunch special and I loved it! With this special you get a sushi roll and the choice of two sides. For my sushi roll, I went with the Rock n' Roll (snowcrab, tempura shrimp and avocado).
